menuItems.description: Crispy crepe roasted with pure Amul Butter, packed with succulent spiced paneer stuffing.

menuItems.name: Rawa Mysoor Plain Dosa
menuItems.description: Lacy semolina crepe lined with tangy Mysore red paste, cooked to a delicate crunch.

menuItems.name: Rawa Mysoor Masala Dosa
menuItems.description: Lacy semolina crepe brushed with spicy Mysore paste, filled with savory spiced potato mash.

menuItems.name: Rawa Plain Dosa
menuItems.description: Golden lacy semolina crepe infused with whole cumin, crushed black peppercorns and curry leaves.

menuItems.name: Rawa Masala Dosa
menuItems.description: Lacy crisp semolina crepe stuffed with authentic spiced potato aloo masala.

menuItems.name: Rawa Onion Dosa
menuItems.description: Crunchy semolina crepe scattered with sweet diced onions and green chillies.

menuItems.name: Rawa Onion Masala Dosa
menuItems.description: Signature crispy rawa crepe studded with caramelized onions and filled with potato masala.

menuItems.name: Rawa Coconut Dosa
menuItems.description: Fragrant semolina crepe prepared with freshly grated coconut roasted golden.

menuItems.name: Rawa Coconut Masala Dosa
menuItems.description: Lacy semolina crepe packed with fresh grated coconut and flavorful potato masala.

menuItems.name: Ghee Roasted Masala Dosa
menuItems.description: Decadent pure ghee roasted crisp dosa stuffed with aromatic seasoned potato mash.

menuItems.name: Upma
menuItems.description: Traditional roasted semolina porridge tempered with mustard seeds, ginger, curry leaves, and cashews.

menuItems.name: Set Dosa
menuItems.description: Trio of ultra-soft, spongy, melt-in-the-mouth dosas served with spicy sagu/sambar and chutneys.

menuItems.name: 1 Idli + 1 Vada + Mini Masala Dosa + Mini Onion Uttappam
menuItems.description: Royal tasting feast: 1 soft steamed idli, 1 crunchy medu vada, mini masala dosa, and mini onion uttapam.

menuItems.name: Onion Uttappam
menuItems.description: Thick, fluffy fermented pancake crowned with sweet caramelized red onions and green coriander.

menuItems.name: Onion Tomato Uttappam
menuItems.description: Soft and thick pancake generously loaded with sweet onions, juicy ripe tomatoes and fresh chillies.

menuItems.name: Mix Veg Uttappam
menuItems.description: Savory thick pancake studded with grated carrots, bell peppers, tomatoes, and sweet onions.

menuItems.name: Coconut Uttappam
menuItems.description: Thick pancake generously topped with freshly grated coastal coconut and green chillies.

menuItems.name: Masala Uttappam
menuItems.description: Fluffy pancake topped with signature spiced potato aloo masala and coriander leaves.

menuItems.name: Paneer Uttappam
menuItems.description: Plump savory pancake smothered with seasoned cottage cheese cubes and diced onions.

menuItems.description: Two steaming hot fluffy fermented rice cakes served with aromatic lentil sambar and fresh chutney.

menuItems.name: Ghee Podi Idli (2 Pcs.)
menuItems.description: Two soft idlis generously tossed in aromatic pure desi ghee and spicy karam gunpowder podi.

menuItems.name: Fried Idli (3 Pcs.)
menuItems.description: Crispy fried idli fingers seasoned with chaat spices, curry leaves and mustard seeds.

menuItems.name: Vada Sambar (2 Pcs.)
menuItems.description: Two golden crunchy doughnut-shaped lentil fritters spiced with ginger and black peppercorns.

menuItems.name: Dahi Vada (2 Pcs.)
menuItems.description: Two soft vadas immersed in sweet spiced yogurt, tempered with mustard seeds and curry leaves.

menuItems.name: Dal Vada (4 Pcs.)
menuItems.description: Four coarse chana dal patties, deep-fried to a golden crisp with onions, green chillies and curry leaves.

menuItems.name: Idli Vada Combo
menuItems.description: One soft steamed idli and one crispy medu vada, the quintessential South Indian breakfast pair.

menuItems.name: Idli Sambar (1 Pc.)
menuItems.description: Single portion: One steamed fluffy rice idli served with hot sambar and fresh coconut chutney.

menuItems.name: Vada Sambar (1 Pc.)
menuItems.description: Single portion: One golden crispy medu vada served with hot sambar and fresh coconut chutney.

menuItems.name: Sambar Rice
menuItems.description: Slow-simmered rice infused with spiced dal sambar and seasonal vegetables, served with papad.

menuItems.name: Lemon Rice
menuItems.description: Steamed rice tempered with fresh lemon juice, turmeric, crunchy roasted peanuts, and curry leaves.

menuItems.name: Tomato Rice
menuItems.description: Aromatic basmati rice cooked with ripe tangy tomatoes, whole spices, mustard seeds, and cashews.

menuItems.name: Coconut Rice
menuItems.description: Mildly fragrant rice tossed with freshly grated coconut, cashews, mustard seeds, and dried chillies.

menuItems.name: Curd Rice
menuItems.description: Comforting cooked rice mixed with fresh curd, tempered with mustard seeds, curry leaves, and ginger.

menuItems.name: Filter Coffee
menuItems.description: Freshly brewed traditional chicory blend South Indian Kaapi frothed with whole boiled milk.

menuItems.name: Cold Drinks
menuItems.description: Assorted chilled carbonated soft beverages in can/bottle. Sold strictly at printed MRP.

menuItems.name: Water
menuItems.description: Packaged premium drinking water. Sold strictly at printed MRP.
